create.name: Bhante Sujatha
create.bio:
Bhante Sujatha is a Theravada Buddhist monk from Kandy in Sri Lanka, often called the loving-kindness monk. He took robes as a boy of eleven, trained at a monastic school in Kandy and taught there before moving to Brisbane in 1993 to teach meditation. A few years later he came to the American Midwest, helped found a Sri Lankan temple in Michigan, and then settled in McHenry County, Illinois, where classes he began in 2003 at a local college and a Unitarian church grew into the Blue Lotus Buddhist Temple in Woodstock. He serves as its abbot.

His teaching is relaxed and practical rather than doctrinal. He pairs metta, or loving-kindness, meditation with mindfulness practice, and his dharma talks look at how ordinary work, family life and difficult moments can become the ground of practice. He wants complete beginners to feel at home, and he speaks about kindness, patience and joy in plain terms. Alongside weekly sessions at the temple and on Zoom, he visits colleges and communities across the United States. His books include Sitting on the Toolbox, written with Stacey Stern, and he shares many guided meditations and talks online.

books.title: Sitting on the Toolbox: Buddha's Wisdom for a Joyful Life
books.author: Bhante Sujatha, Stacey Stern
books.description: Bhante Sujatha and Stacey Stern set out the Buddha's teachings as everyday tools: kindness, patience, letting go and paying attention. Short chapters mix teaching stories with simple practices a newcomer can try.

books.title: Empty, Empty. Happy, Happy.: The Essential Teachings of a Simple Monk
books.author: Tyler Lewke, Bhante Sujatha
books.description: A collection of brief stories and sayings gathered from Bhante Sujatha's teaching, put together with his student Tyler Lewke. It reads as a light, warm introduction to his way of practising loving-kindness in ordinary life.

books.title: Morning Coffee with Bhante: A Collection of Inspirational Wisdom
books.author: Bhante Sujatha
books.description: A small book of Bhante Sujatha's short sayings, gathered from a long-running morning discussion group, with a foreword by its moderator Michael Fronczak. Each line is meant to be easy to carry into the day.

free_resources.title: Bhante Sujatha on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A library of guided loving-kindness and mindfulness meditations from Bhante Sujatha, along with short talks on Buddhist teachings such as the Four Noble Truths. All of it is free to listen to in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Weekly guided meditation at the Blue Lotus Temple
free_resources.description: The temple in Woodstock, Illinois, holds hour-long sessions several times a week that combine loving-kindness meditation, mindfulness, chanting and a short dharma talk. They are open to everyone, whatever their faith.
